# tenured contact point

The contact point an address-tenure concerns.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:AddressTenure`](../classes/gmeow-AddressTenure.md) -> [`gmeow:ContactPoint`](../classes/gmeow-ContactPoint.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:tenuredContactPoint`](gmeow-tenuredContactPoint.md) from [`gmeow:AddressTenure`](../classes/gmeow-AddressTenure.md) to [`gmeow:ContactPoint`](../classes/gmeow-ContactPoint.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:AddressTenure`](../classes/gmeow-AddressTenure.md), [`gmeow:ContactPoint`](../classes/gmeow-ContactPoint.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the contact point a [`gmeow:AddressTenure`](../classes/gmeow-AddressTenure.md) is about — the channel held over the tenure's interval.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting more than one contact point per tenure (it is functional) and avoid using it for the agent who held it (that is [`gmeow:addressHolder`](gmeow-addressHolder.md)).

### How to use

- Point the tenure at its single [`gmeow:ContactPoint`](../classes/gmeow-ContactPoint.md); pair with [`gmeow:addressHolder`](gmeow-addressHolder.md) and the time-scoped interval to complete the situation.
